description: Source file implementing RuntimeManagerHandler class for managing application runtime states, including initialization, control commands (run, kill, suspend, resume, hibernate, wake), and event notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Handles runtime management operations and event notifications for applications.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Inner class for handling runtime manager events such as start, termination, failure, and state changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up and unregisters the runtime manager.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime information for a specific application instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts an application with specified parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes up an application instance and sets its runtime state.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Dispatches runtime events to the registered event handler.
